Entrepreneurship Readiness Assessment™ (ERA)

What Kind of Builder Are You?

Every entrepreneurial journey begins somewhere.

At the empowerHER Legacy Institute, we believe the strongest journeys begin with understanding how you naturally build.

Every entrepreneur brings different strengths to the table.
Some naturally lead with vision.
Others excel at strategy.
Some instinctively move ideas into action.
Others build through sustainability, adaptability or long-term stewardship.

There isn’t one right way to build a successful business.
Every business is different.
Every entrepreneur is different.
Your blueprint should honor both.

That’s why every entrepreneurial journey through the empowerHER Legacy Institute begins with the Entrepreneurship Readiness Assessment™.

In about 10 minutes, you’ll discover your Lead Builder™, Supporting Builder™ and Entrepreneurship Readiness Map™, receive personalized insights into your natural strengths and growth opportunities and learn how the PMFRL Methodology™ can help you build in a way that fits you.
